en.summary: Fixes real response-reconstruction bugs in VX_mem_streamer for batched and duplicate-address traffic, although the commit is wrapped in a large refactor.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the memory streamer contains bug fixes.
The patch changes central DUT logic in hw/rtl/libs/VX_mem_streamer.sv, not tests or host tooling.
The new metadata tracking for original masks, duplicate requests, and batch indices directly affects returned lane masks and data.
disqualifiers: The patch is a large refactor, so the entry should stay at medium confidence and focus only on the bug mechanisms clearly supported by the code.
evidence: The fix adds rsp_dups and rsp_orig_mask state, which the old implementation did not preserve across queued requests.
Response assembly now uses rsp_orig_mask[stag_raddr] for final crsp_mask and uses rsp_dup to decide whether to broadcast one returned datum across duplicated lanes.
The batch tag path is rewritten around BATCH_SEL_BITS and the response tag read address becomes mem_rsp_tag_s[BATCH_SEL_BITS +: QUEUE_ADDRW], showing the old batch bookkeeping was error-prone.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A memory coalescer or streamer that collapses duplicate lane addresses and splits a wide request into multiple bank-sized batches must preserve the original per-lane request mask and whether duplicate-address broadcast is expected. If that metadata is not retained until response assembly, the unit can return the wrong mask, lose lanes, or broadcast data incorrectly when the batched responses arrive.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Wide memory requests that are split into multiple batches, especially when duplicate-address optimization is enabled or when responses are returned incrementally.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the stored original response mask and duplicate-request flag, then reconstruct the final response only from the currently returning batch mask and data.
portability_notes: Map this to any request coalescer, bank streamer, or gather/scatter front-end that merges or batches per-lane requests.
The key bug is loss of original lane identity between request acceptance and response reconstruction.
A faithful reinjection does not require reverting the whole refactor; preserving the wrong response-metadata policy is enough.
concrete_injection_steps: When a request enters the queue, do not save the original per-lane mask or the duplicate-address indicator alongside the request tag.
At response time, derive the outgoing lane mask only from the current returning batch instead of the original request footprint.
If duplicate-address collapsing exists, decide whether to broadcast returned data using only the current batch state or a fixed lane, rather than using preserved request metadata.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Queued response reconstruction for duplicate-address and multi-batch requests
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds rsp_dups and rsp_orig_mask bookkeeping, rewrites batch tag handling with BATCH_SEL_BITS, and rebuilds final crsp_mask/crsp_data from preserved request metadata instead of ad hoc batch-local state.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the rsp_dups/rsp_orig_mask state and revert final response assembly to rely only on current batch-local mask/data, as in the pre-fix logic.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Duplicate-address or multi-batch memory operations return the wrong rsp_mask, lose some lanes, or replicate the wrong datum across multiple lanes.
evidence_for_injection: The new state variables exist solely to preserve information from request issue time to response assembly time.
The fixed code explicitly distinguishes duplicate-response broadcasting from ordinary batch reconstruction.
The response tag extraction and batch-index logic were changed together with the mask/data assembly, indicating a real bookkeeping bug rather than mere cleanup.
notes: This is a mixed refactor-plus-fix commit, so the injection plan intentionally targets the clearest correctness mechanism instead of every code motion in the patch.
The plan is still concrete enough for cross-DUT injection because many banked memory front-ends share this request-mask preservation problem.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 VX_mem_streamer 在分批请求和重复地址场景下真实存在的响应重建错误，尽管整个补丁被包在一次较大的重构中。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明 memory streamer 中包含 bug fixes。
补丁修改的是 hw/rtl/libs/VX_mem_streamer.sv 中的核心 DUT 逻辑，而不是测试或宿主工具。
新增的原始 mask、重复请求标记和 batch index 跟踪会直接影响返回的 lane mask 与数据。
disqualifiers: 该补丁属于大规模重构，因此本条目应保持 medium 置信度，并只陈述代码中有明确证据支持的 bug 机制。
evidence: 修复新增了 rsp_dups 和 rsp_orig_mask 状态，而旧实现没有跨队列请求保存这些信息。
响应拼装现在使用 rsp_orig_mask[stag_raddr] 作为最终 crsp_mask，并使用 rsp_dup 决定是否要把同一个返回数据广播到重复 lane。
batch tag 路径被改写为围绕 BATCH_SEL_BITS 组织，响应 tag 的读地址也变成 mem_rsp_tag_s[BATCH_SEL_BITS +: QUEUE_ADDRW]，说明旧的 batch 记账方式存在问题。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 会折叠重复 lane 地址、并把宽请求拆成多个 bank 大小批次的 memory coalescer/streamer，必须一直保存原始的每-lane 请求 mask，以及是否应进行重复地址广播。如果这些元数据在响应拼装前丢失，那么当分批响应返回时，模块就可能输出错误的 mask、漏掉部分 lane，或把数据错误广播。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 分批重复请求的响应重建
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 宽 memory 请求被拆成多个 batch，尤其是在启用重复地址优化或响应分段返回时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 丢弃保存下来的原始响应 mask 和重复请求标志，并仅根据当前返回批次的 mask/data 去重建最终响应。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何会合并、分发或分批处理 per-lane 请求的 request coalescer、bank streamer 或 gather/scatter 前端。
核心 bug 是在请求进入队列后到响应重建前，原始 lane 身份信息被丢失。
无需回退整个重构；只要恢复错误的响应元数据策略，就足以复现该问题。
concrete_injection_steps: 在请求入队时，不再把原始 per-lane mask 或重复地址标志和请求 tag 一起保存。
在响应阶段，只根据当前返回批次来推导输出 lane mask，而不是依据原始请求足迹。
如果设计存在重复地址折叠，则在决定是否广播返回数据时，只依赖当前批次状态或固定 lane，而不是依赖已保存的请求元数据。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 重复地址与多批次请求的队列化响应重建逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了 rsp_dups 与 rsp_orig_mask 记账，使用 BATCH_SEL_BITS 重写 batch tag 处理，并根据保存下来的请求元数据重建最终 crsp_mask/crsp_data，而不再依赖临时的 batch 局部状态。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 恢复陈旧的响应记账方式
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 rsp_dups/rsp_orig_mask 状态，并让最终响应拼装重新只依赖当前 batch 的局部 mask/data，回到修复前逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 重复地址或多批次的 memory 操作会返回错误的 rsp_mask、丢失部分 lane，或把错误的数据复制到多个 lane。
evidence_for_injection: 新增状态变量的唯一目的，就是把请求发起时的信息保留到响应拼装阶段。
修复后的代码明确区分了“重复地址广播响应”和“普通 batch 重建”两种路径。
响应 tag 提取、batch index 逻辑和 mask/data 拼装一起被修改，说明这不是纯粹代码整理，而是真实的记账错误。
notes: 这是重构与修复混合的提交，因此注入方案有意只针对证据最清晰的正确性机制，而不是回退所有代码挪动。
该方案仍然具有跨 DUT 可移植性，因为许多 banked memory 前端都会遇到这种请求 mask 保真问题。
